The canonicalization scheme (JSON Canonicalization Scheme) the engine uses, making hashes transport-invariant since H5.
The seam through which frontend hashing and operations route to the wasm32 build of the Rust engine; absent artifact fails with WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT.
Produces ModelHashEvidence (sha256, rfc8785_jcs, computed_local_preview) for a preview model, stable under key reordering.
Hashes the persisted project-envelope payload only, excluding storage summary and the envelope-hash carrier field.
Desktop-only Tauri-backed validation of an already-parsed library import payload; reports software findings only, never legal/certification/compliance.
The three import library kinds: material, section, component.
The enumerated outcome of a library-import validation.
The severity axis splitting findings into blocking/quarantine (block the import) versus review_required (advisory human review).
Pure helper indexing a stored library document's record ids and per-record de-duplicated value-slot ids, mirroring the desktop resolver.
Cross-engine corpus of operation cases run through adapter and wasm lanes to prove native↔wasm parity against Rust-blessed expectations.
The honest route an operation outcome reports for which engine answered.
Named blocking diagnostic the wasm engine returns (in an input-error envelope) for malformed JSON instead of trapping.
The editor-operation seam adapter containing only routing and engine-status reporting; all operation semantics live in core/model_operations/operation_applier.
Resolves the rule-check status the analysis-run record carries: a recognized aggregate over the solve rule_check, else fallback (never a false pass).
Builds the app-held analysis-run envelope for a solved result, composing a rule-check aggregate without mutating the hash-bound raw solve envelope.
Comparison delta classification indicating no default engineering tolerance threshold is applied.
Browser-preview mirror of the backend transform chain classifying a document as current/migrated/newer_than_supported/unsupported_schema without coercion.
The supported model document schema version (0.2.0 per DEC-033), mirrored from the backend.
The browser preview storage mode: in-memory snapshot, no SQLite store/migration ledger, no repository-default writes.
